text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to prohibit parking at all times on the south side of West Deane Park Drive, between The East Mall and Rabbit Lane. The proposed prohibition is to address concerns with respect to parked vehicles, within the subject area, causing congestion and difficulties for vehicles entering West Deane Park Drive from The East Mall.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of West Deane Park Drive, between The East Mall and Rabbit Lane.
